from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information about a single paper in the collection, including its title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper as written in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (from the known collection) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all papers found in the document collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
